purpose: Validate one development-selected score-aware fusion continuation after preserving the completed first frozen round

reserved_before_results.note: Reserved before any second-round heldout execution. Shared templates still limit generalization; no later quality change will be selected using these outcomes.

public_verification.note: All public heldout questions were measured in the first frozen round and are now regression data. No query wording or per-query heldout outcome selected the new formula; its acceptance used only dev61 and public-dev128.

goal_assessment.quality: Compare delivered evidence recall and complete-evidence rate on identical queries and budgets; retain gains, losses and category regressions.
goal_assessment.tokens: Name the tokenizer and actual consumption surface; retain both shared-assembly and native-response costs including documented follow-up reads.
goal_assessment.latency: Report p50 and p95 with explicit boundaries; different transports or missing native read paths cannot establish end-to-end superiority.
goal_assessment.answer_quality: Not established by source-evidence retrieval. A fixed answering model and paired answer evaluation are required for that separate claim.

selection_rule: One fixed formula, no weight sweep: 2 * normalized exact BM25 + normalized stem BM25 when routes differ. Three independent fixtures and zero dev complete-query losses plus no aggregate recall decrease required at both caps. Do not call validation gates proof of the overall product goal.
